title: Don't put off until tomorrow what you can do today.

voice.name: Fernanda - Calm Storytelling
voice.source: ElevenLabs Voice Library (GET /v1/shared-voices), vom Nutzer gewaehlt nach 4 Proberunden

sentences.text: Tomorrow is the most dangerous word you know.
Every day you wait, the mountain gets taller.
But the first step? It's never as hard as you think.
Five minutes. That's all it takes to begin.
Do it badly. Do it scared. Just do it today.
Because one day, you won't have a tomorrow left.

mood_cue.rising: she said, her voice rising with energy and determination.
mood_cue.quiet: she said quietly and seriously, almost a whisper.
mood_cue.strong: she said with fierce, powerful conviction.
